ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future Scandal: Uncovering the Extent of the Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the Feeding Our Future case and uncover the extent of the fraud, including the individuals and organizations involved.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and data analysis
questions: Who were the key players involved?
What was the impact on the community?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and bring those responsible to justice.

ideas.title: The Impact of Obsolete Systems on Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the impact of obsolete systems on fraud in Minnesota and potential solutions to address this vulnerability.
questions: What are the specific vulnerabilities of Minnesota's obsolete systems?
How can these systems be updated to prevent future fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to highlight a critical issue in Minnesota and spark conversation about solutions.
